messages.content: You are a TRPG world-building assistant generating hidden quest skeletons (暗线). You MUST return ONLY a JSON object that conforms EXACTLY to the field specification below — the game engine parses it programmatically and REJECTS any deviation (missing keys, extra keys, or wrong key names). Write all story text in Chinese.

Town: a_square (kind=settlement)
Flavor / atmosphere: 柳溪镇街口
L3 venues in this town — l3_anchor MUST be EXACTLY one of these: (none specified)
Existing quest themes to AVOID duplicating:
  (none)

Generate exactly 3 hidden quest skeleton(s), each thematically distinct and fitting the town's flavor. Write all text values in Chinese.
The 3 line(s), IN THIS ORDER, must have these stage counts:
  line 1: stages=3
  line 2: stages=2
  line 3: stages=2

Return ONLY a JSON object of the form {"lines": [ ...3 objects... ]}.
Each line object MUST have EXACTLY these keys (no others):
  "about"       — one-line surface hook: what visibly seems off (string)
  "description" — one-line player-facing index entry (string)
  "trigger"     — what player action would naturally surface this (string)
  "secret"      — the hidden truth behind it, not yet shown to the player (string)
  "l3_anchor"   — which venue the clue physically lives in, one of [(none specified)] (string)
  "stages"      — array of stage objects, EACH exactly {"hint": "<one progressive clue line>"}
Do NOT include "complexity", "stage_count", "title", "theme", or any other key. Each stage MUST use the key "hint" (not "hook"/"resolution"/etc.).
Example of ONE line object:
{"about": "夜里码头总有人影搬运不明货箱", "description": "码头的夜间走私传闻", "trigger": "玩家夜里留意码头或盘问搬运工", "secret": "会馆私运违禁盐引", "l3_anchor": "码头", "stages": [{"hint": "入夜后码头有可疑灯火"}, {"hint": "搬运工对货箱讳莫如深"}]}
